run_VoteNet_training: run the VoteNet 3D object detection training pipeline on SUNRGBD or ScanNet datasets with Hydra config
run_VoteNet_testing: run the VoteNet 3D object detection testing pipeline on a validation dataset with Hydra config
run_BoxNet_training: run the BoxNet 3D object detection training pipeline using the main entry point with config
load_state_with_same_shape: load pretrained model weights by filtering keys that match the target model's state dict shape
setup_logging: setup logging with a StreamHandler that formats output with the hostname and timestamp
